dogecoin.text: @panchiluu I don't recommend Dogecoin as a long-term investment. Short-term ki ok.. only because of the hype.

I agree with most things Elon Musk says.. except the things he said about DogeCoin. I don't believe that DogeCoin is the future of cryptocurrency. 

The real-life applications of Doge are very limited. Other coins like Cardano have far more long term value.
